title: staged-token-coordinator-and-kv-coalescer-for-overlapped-prefetching
author: Asha Menon
body:
Summary: Introduces a staged token coordinator (STC) and a KV coalescer to enable tighter overlap between token prefetch (prefill) and decode stages without increasing worst-case latency. The STC moves from a coarse stage-boundary handshake to a token-window-driven handoff that lets small chunks of KV state be streamed earlier. The KV coalescer batches and deduplicates overlapping KV prefetch requests across concurrent inflight prefills, reducing redundant GPU kernel invocations and improving token throughput under medium-length sequences.

Motivation & context: Ongoing work around overlapped prefill/decode showed good p50 improvements but left tail latency and redundant kernel launches when many similar prefill windows were requested concurrently (see ENG-4821). This change is a lighter-weight alternative to full speculative-chunking: it aims for predictable SLOs while recovering batching opportunity lost by strict stage boundaries.

What this changes:
- Adds staged_token_coordinator that slices prefill windows into small token-windows (configurable, default 32 tokens) and provides a single subscription interface for decode to consume early-ready KV shards.
- Implements kv_coalescer that merges KV prefetch intents from multiple requests within a short coalescing window (default 6ms) and deduplicates identical keys.
- Introduces a soft backpressure policy to avoid overwhelming the decode side: STC tracks in-flight kv-shards and delays prefetch extension when soft_limit exceeded.
- Runtime knobs exposed via redwood/config/runtime.yaml: token_window_size, kv_coalesce_ms, stc_soft_limit.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-4821)
- [x] Unit tests for coordinator and coalescer
- [x] End-to-end microbench that compares baseline vs STC on local bench lab
- [x] Feature-flag gating (stc_enabled) for gradual rollout

Commits (summary):
- feat(stc): initial staged token coordinator, windowing and subscription API
- perf(kv): implement kv_coalescer with dedupe and merge strategies
- fix(runtime): soft backpressure and metrics for stc
- test: add unit + integration tests for coalescer/stc
- docs: runtime knobs and rollout notes

Files touched (high-level):
- serving/runtime/staged_token_coordinator.rs (new)  -- core STC implementation
- serving/runtime/kv_coalescer.rs (new) -- merges prefetch intents and dedupe
- serving/runtime/handshake.rs -- replace coarse handshake with STC subscription points (small adapt)
- serving/bench/bench_stc.py -- microbench harness and plotting script
- config/runtime.yaml -- knobs and defaults
- tests/stc_unit.rs, tests/kv_coalescer_integration.rs
- docs/ops/stc_rollout.md

Patch excerpt (illustrative):
// staged_token_coordinator.rs (simplified)
impl StagedTokenCoordinator {
    fn extend_prefill(&self, req_id: RequestId, token_range: Range) {
        // slice range into windows and publish ready kv-shards as they resolve
        for window in token_range.windows(self.window_size) {
            self.publish_shard(req_id, window.start, window.end);
        }
    }
}

Review conversation (highlights):
- Brian Chen (review): "Nice targeted approach. My main concern is metric coverage for when we dedupe keys across different model versions (we need to avoid cross-version contamination). Please add strict version tagging on coalescer entries."
- Asha (author): "Added model_version tag to coalescer keys and unit tests that simulate version skew. See second commit."
- Omar Farouk (review): "Can we avoid adding a new full async queue per request? The current impl had a queue in Stc per-request which looked heavy."
- Asha: "Reworked STC to use a shared slab of subscriptions with lightweight tokens instead of per-request heap allocations; updated bench results (see bench_stc.py)."
- Lena Rodriguez (review, approval): "Bench looks convincing for medium-length sequences; approved for gradual rollout behind flag. Please watch p99 during canary."

CI / checks summary: 
- linux-unit-tests: pass
- bench-lab-smoke: pass
- lint: pass (one clippy suggestion addressed)
- integration: pass
- upgrade-checks: pass

Bench results (short):
- Baseline: p50 token latency 7.8ms, p95 34ms, throughput 1200 tokens/s
- With STC+coalescer (default knobs): p50 6.1ms (22% improvement), p95 28ms (17% improvement), throughput 1375 tokens/s (14% uplift).
- Memory/CPU overhead: +2% CPU, +0.8% GPU kernel invocations (reduced overall kernel invocations by ~9% due to dedupe)

Rollout plan:
- Feature flag stc_enabled=false by default
- Canary on dedicated pool with 5% traffic for 48h, monitor p50/p95/p99, kernel invocation rate, kv-prefetch queue depth, and cross-version key hits.
- If stable, increase to 25% then full rollout over one week.

Release notes (short):
- runtime: staged token coordinator + KV coalescer improve token-level overlap between prefill and decode; reduces redundant KV prefetch work and improves p50/p95 latency for medium-length sequences. Controlled by stc_enabled flag.

Follow-ups / known limitations: 
- Does not yet implement speculative eviction of coalesced shards for extremely long sequences; follow-up ENG-4899 tracks an aggressive eviction policy.
- May not yield visible gains on very short (<16 token) prefills; runtime defaults keep token_window_size configurable.

Merge outcome: squashed and merged by Lena Rodriguez on 2026-02-24. Feature gated and documented.
